findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Numerous dead bugs are observed around the inside rim of the display chest freezer in front of the register. The PIC is instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mop is observed being stored in dirty mop water in the bathroom. The PIC was notified and instructed to stored so that it can drip dry when not in use. Ensure proper storage moving forward.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

Paper towels were not available at the hand sink in the bathroom. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tight fitting and self-closing door. 

The restroom door does not have a correctly functioning self closer. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Damp mop observed in a pile in the restroom. Store wet mops so that they can air dry without soiling their surroundings. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 6-501.16     [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Restroom door is neither self-closing nor tight-fitting. There is a significant gap between the bottom of the door and the floor. Repair so door is self-closing and tight-fitting. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 6-501.19     [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT: Frost build up observed in the ice cream freezer. Clean routinely to prevent accumulation. Follow up at next routine inspection.
Ref. 4-602.13     [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
No triple sink present for washing food contact equipment (like an ice scoop). Cease handling ice without appropriate equipment for sanitizing. CORRECTED.
Ref. 4-501.114     [P/Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels available in the restroom. Disposable paper towels must be provided. CORRECTED.
Ref. 6-301.12     [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
The only handwashing sink is located in the restroom. If any level of food handling (other than prepackaged foods) is going to occur, an additional (not in the restroom) handsink would be required. Cease handling ice without appropriate handwashing facilities. CORRECTED. 
Ref. 2-301.15     [Pf]

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed brownies with no label. PIC stated someone gave brownies to store. No TCS foods from unapproved source can be sold to customers. Corrected. PIC discarded brownies and stated he would no longer sell unapproved products. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed Styrofoam used as bottom rack for Reach-in Freezer. All non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth, durable and easily cleanable. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed frost build up in chest freezer and reach-in freezer. 
Observed reach-in coolers to be soiled with debris on racks. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels in bathroom. Supply paper towels. 
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.citation_text:
750.100 - Styrofoam cups with portions of ice were observed in top of food freezer. Operator portioned ice from bags sold at the facility. Operator was advised the store does not have the facilities to allow for such a practice (no handsink; no 3 part sink). Ice must only be sold in original bags and not portioned for individual sale. Operator stated he understood. All cups of ice were removed from the freezer and discarded during inspection.

Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) - (R) Ice cream freezer did not have a thermometer inside. Provide thermometers for all coolers and freezers used for storage of potentially  hazardous foods.

All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text:
750.130 - Carton of raw eggs was observed sitting on top of deli meats on a shelf in the 3 door cooler. All other eggs were observed in the bottom of the cooler, but there was not enough space to place the carton observed with the deli meats in the bottom of the cooler. Carton of eggs was moved to a cooler located by the drive thru window in the manager's office (cooler at 38F),

All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or away from raw foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - A) (R) Ice cream freezer had heavy frost/ice accumulation inside. Defrost the ice cream freezer.

B) Styrofoam was observed in the bottom of the food freezer. Remove the Styrofoam from the freezer.

C) Old bubble wrap was observed around the handles of food freezer. Bubble wrap was removed during the inspection.

D) Cardboard was observed in 3 door cooler as a divider and/or shelf liner. Remove cardboard and provide another cleanable material to act as a divider and/or lining for shelves.

Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) bottom inside all coolers (dust/debris);
B) tracks of all sliding door cooler (debris/dust/dead bugs);   and
C) around seal and doors of ice cream freezer (debris).

Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1110 & 1120 - A) All surfaces in the restroom were soiled with splash and general buildup of soil.  Clean everything and all surfaces in the restroom. 

Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

B) Paper towels were not available in the restroom. Provide paper towels in the restroom.

A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1130 - Lid to dumpster was open upon arrival of inspector. Close the lids of the dumpster when it is not in use.

Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers and must be kept closed when not in use.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floors were soiled under/around coolers and freezers and in the restroom. Clean the floors.

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed that the chest freezer holding ice cream did not contain a thermometer.
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
Provide thermometers in all refrigeration units.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of cereal stored on the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. 
 Properly store and protect food.
CORRECTED= Boxes were placed on pallets.
**Note= A delivery truck had just delivered new inventory, and the staff had not finished putting stock away when inspector arrived.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that there are some floor tiles in disrepair (cracked or broken), near the rest room door and near the door to the office. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
Repair the floor tiles where necessary.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed that reach in freezer 1 and reach in cooler 2 had a light bulb in each unit that was not shielded.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage. 
Provide properly shielded lights. Place shields over bulbs, or replace bulbs with shatterproof bulbs.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed that the damp mop was stored in the mop bucket, not hung up to dry. 
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
Store damp mop hanging upright between uses to promote air drying.
